question: In which year was Kalidas Samman established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian state of **Madhya Pradesh** annually bestows the **Kalidas Samman, **a prize for the arts.
 
• The honour bears **Kalidasa's name,** a well-known** Classical Sanskrit author** from ancient India.
 
• In **1980, the Kalidas Samman** was first given out.
 
• Initially, it was awarded every other year in the categories of **classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidasa:**

 
 
• The **greatest poet and playwright** of ancient India, Kalidasa, wrote in Classical Sanskrit.
 
• The **Vedas, the Ramayaa, the Mahabharata, and the Puraas** are the main sources for his plays and poetry.
 
• He wrote** Raghuvamsa**, which details Raghuvamsa's whole family genealogy, from Dilipa to Rama.
 
• **"Meghaduta**" is the name of a poem he penned.
 
• The epic **Kumarasambhava**, written by Kalidas, is a significant work.
 
• Many poems about the **beginnings of the goddess Parvati** can be found in Kumarasambhava.
